name: Mendeliar’s hearing contacts
goals: Get competing claims heard without treating a gift as proof.
Trace who heard a report firsthand and who owes its bearer a favour.
bio: A commercial grievance reaches court through men who would not all sit at the same table. A debtor, a merchant and an admiral each have their own reason to pass on a story.
notes: fact: The Annals connects Dewana, Mendeliar, Kittul and the admiral through a gift, debt and accusations; its account calls the treason report false (Brown ch. XXII, pp. 160–164)
gameplay: This grouping includes opponents and intermediaries, not a united body; Rangan is a fictional petitioner (people-factions.md §3; data/merchants/sri_rangan.json)
